purpose: Offline audit of whether arm and gripper same-target utility have different dependence on observation delay.
primary_question: Does the utility or reliability of historical same-target predictions vary systematically between the six-dimensional arm and scalar gripper groups?

source.cache_kind: Fresh dense-query SmolVLA postprocessed action chunks
source.cache_schema: episode_i has shape [T, 50, 7]; cache[q, d] targets physical step q+d
source.action_domain: postprocessed relative-action domain; gripper range is fixed to [-1, 1]

separate_inspected_cache.reason: different ACT checkpoint/cohort, 82 episodes, and 100-step chunks

delays.availability: For target t and delay d, q=t-d must be nonnegative and d must be smaller than the source chunk horizon. Target t remains within the executed episode.

alignment.same_target_test: source query q plus chunk offset d equals target t

gripper.sign_rule: np.sign in {-1, 0, +1}; zero is not remapped

revision.normalization: arm IQR scales are fitted from all development Fresh cache[q,0,:6] rows only; no held-out values enter scales

primary_utility.name: normalized_same_target_revision_utility
primary_utility.direction: higher is more stable same-target agreement; this is offline consistency, not guaranteed control utility

heterogeneity.name: H_temp
heterogeneity.formula: mean over d in {0,4,8,16,20,32} of abs(U_arm(d)-U_grip(d))
heterogeneity.aggregation: task-level profiles; each task has equal weight in macro summaries
heterogeneity.threshold_rule: For each group, threshold is the development-task median U_g(16); first available delay with U_g(d) below that threshold is descriptive only.

demonstration_agreement.reason: The existing eight-task Fresh cache stores policy chunks only. No correctly aligned expert action table is present in the existing protocol/artifacts, and expert labels will not be reconstructed from questionable paths.

existing_source_reliability.source: historical git artifact at 6ed5d06: experiments/dynamic_reliability_horizon/oracle_group_horizon_metrics.json and source_context_ablation/*
existing_source_reliability.target_definition: Y_refresh(k) is prefix survival of old cached A_t[k] against fresh cached A_{t+k}[0]. Arm is valid when max(translation normalized RMS, rotation normalized RMS) <= 1.0; gripper is valid when normalized absolute error <= 1.0 and command signs agree.
existing_source_reliability.comparability: Semantically compatible with source-age persistence, but it is a frozen ACT artifact on a different cohort and is not numerically pooled into this SmolVLA H_temp score.
existing_source_reliability.reuse: Report validated group-wise reliability curves and hard-horizon failure as supporting interpretation only.

closed_loop_stage.use: descriptive Spearman correlation and scatter only; no outcome is used to define H_temp

future_module_ladder_if_supported: M2 whole-action sparse CogACT-style similarity weighting
M4 group-specific delay prior plus group-wise CogACT
M5 anchored group-wise temporal memory: newest joint anchor plus group-specific historical residual/fusion
M6 optional reliability-weighted anchored group memory
